steps.name: full-50-canonical-E2E-after-guarded-Plug-delete-modal
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'CANONICAL_50_VISUAL_E2E'
LCL_E2E_PORT=5293 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --workers=1 --reporter=json >/tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-189-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-189-e2e.err || {
 echo 'E2E_FAILED'
 python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-189-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.index('{'):]);print('STATS',j.get('stats'))
 def walk(ss):
  for suite in ss:
   for sp in suite.get('specs',[]):
    for t in sp.get('tests',[]):
     if t.get('status') not in ('expected','skipped'):
      print('FAILED',sp.get('title'),t.get('status'))
      for r in t.get('results',[]):
       if r.get('error'):print('ERROR',r['error'].get('message','')[:1550])
   walk(suite.get('suites',[]))
 walk(j.get('suites',[]))
except Exception as e:print('RESULT_PARSE_FAILED',str(e),s[-1600:])
PY
 tail -20 /tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-189-e2e.err
 exit 54
}
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-189-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
stats=json.loads(s[s.index('{'):])['stats']
print('VISUAL_E2E_STATS',stats)
assert stats['expected']==50 and stats['unexpected']==0 and stats['skipped']==0 and stats['flaky']==0
PY
echo 'E2E_50_50_PASS_NO_SNAPSHOT_UPDATES'
echo WORKTREE;git status --short
uptime
